jobs.statement: When I walk up to a hackathon booth, I want to immediately see a live, updating visualization, so I can assess technical capability in under 30 seconds.
jobs.evidence: Convergent across all 5 personas in synthetic study; 'instant legibility' = primary wow factor
jobs.wow_moment: Heatmap animating with movement vectors visible above the fold within 2 seconds

jobs.statement: When I evaluate a crowd-monitoring tool, I want to distinguish real sensing from canned demos, so I can trust the system's production viability.
jobs.evidence: Raj + Tomasz both reward honest mode labeling; Raj calls it 'engineering maturity signal'
jobs.wow_moment: Persistent mode badge + ability to toggle Mock -> Replay -> Live and see data actually change

jobs.statement: When I am responsible for a venue zone, I want zone-level occupancy numbers with trend direction, so I can make staffing or routing decisions without leaving the ops room.
jobs.evidence: Maria's core ask ('how many people at Gate 3'); Tomasz agrees numbers beat gradients
jobs.wow_moment: Click a zone -> instant numeric readout with 5-min trend sparkline

jobs.statement: When I demo my project, I want a deterministic event sequence with reset-without-reload, so I can rehearse a pitch that always lands the same way and recover from interruption.
jobs.evidence: Kenji's primary anxiety; Dana confirms timed alert 'proves system is intelligent'
jobs.wow_moment: Keyboard 'R' resets timeline; 90-second alert fires reliably every run

jobs.statement: When I deploy real sensors at a venue, I want to see coverage gaps and sensor health at a glance, so I can route around blind spots before they cause an incident.
jobs.evidence: Maria 'where are my blind spots'; Tomasz 'sensor health is critical'
jobs.wow_moment: Topology view shows uncovered area highlighted in pattern, not just absence

jobs.statement: When I am skeptical of a demo, I want to drill into raw event streams and topology, so I can verify the architecture is defensible.
jobs.evidence: Raj 'show me the API'; Kwame 'reference architecture deployable in an hour'
jobs.wow_moment: Click sensor -> raw event tail (last 10 events with timestamps + RSSI)

jobs.statement: When multiple teams coordinate a single event, I want a shared real-time picture, so we stop reconciling partial views verbally on radio.
jobs.scope_note: Post-MVP. Pitch mentions; MVP shows single-viewer dashboard only.

user_types.label: Spectator (Glanceable)
user_types.needs: Instant comprehension, headline metrics, minimal controls, wow moment

user_types.label: Investigator (Drill-Down)
user_types.needs: Mode switching, raw data access, sensor detail, API visibility

user_types.label: Operator (Action-Oriented)
user_types.needs: Zone numbers, trend arrows, alert routing intent, degradation visibility
